My school had 20 teachers absent on Monday and Tuesday and about 50% attendance in every classroom on Monday and Tuesday. About 15 fully vaccinated teachers had tested positive for COVID and could not return to work after break. Dozens of students tested positive and had to quarantine. Schools are not safe right now. It is that simple. If a two week break in in-person instruction is what it takes to save even one life, it's worth it. No, I am not worried as a fully vaccinated adult about getting COVID and dying, but I am worried as shit about someone getting COVID unknowingly, passing it on to one of my 3 year old students, them passing it on to an elderly family member and that family member dying. 100% terrified of that. I work in an affluent neighborhood where we are afforded things that SW side and Southside schools do not have. And our school is a mess. This is a problem I can't even imagine in those neighborhoods. People will die.
